## Overview
A single pure module `src/lib/core.ts` holds the domain logic; `src/App.tsx` renders it.

## Modules
- `src/lib/core.ts` — domain logic (pure, tested)
- `src/App.tsx` — UI

tasks.title: Core logic and UI
tasks.body: Implement the domain logic in src/lib/core.ts and show it in App. Cover every acceptance criterion with vitest tests in tests/core.test.ts.
